IBPS Clerk Notification 2026: Your Essential Guide to a Banking Career!

Aspiring to build a secure and dynamic career in the banking sector? The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) Clerk recruitment is one of the most sought-after opportunities for graduates across India. While the official notification for IBPS Clerk 2026 (CRP CSA-XVI) is eagerly anticipated, critical exam dates have already been released, giving you a head start on your preparation! This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know about the upcoming IBPS Clerk 2026 recruitment, now officially known as the Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associates (CSA).

IBPS Clerk 2026: Key Dates at a Glance

The IBPS annual calendar has provided clarity on the examination schedule for the IBPS Clerk 2026 recruitment. Mark these important dates in your calendar! The official notification, which will detail vacancies and the online application window, is expected to be released in July/August 2026.

Event Tentative Dates
Official Notification Release July/August 2026 (Expected)
Online Application Start August 2026 (Expected)
Last Date to Apply Online August 2026 (Expected)
Preliminary Examination October 10 & 11, 2026
Main Examination December 27, 2026

Who Can Apply? IBPS Clerk 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Before you begin your application, it’s crucial to understand the eligibility requirements set by IBPS. Ensure you meet all the criteria to avoid any last-minute disqualifications.

1. Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as of August 1, 2026 (tentative date as per previous notifications). This means a candidate must have been born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006 (both dates inclusive).

Age relaxations are applicable for candidates belonging to reserved categories as per government norms:

✅ SC/ST: 5 years

✅ OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years

✅ Persons with Benchmark Disabilities: 10 years

✅ Ex-Servicemen: Actual period of service rendered in the defence forces + 3 years (subject to a maximum age of 50 years)

2. Educational Qualification

A Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognized by the Government of India or any equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government is mandatory.

Important Note: You must possess a valid mark-sheet/degree certificate stating that you are a graduate on the day you register online and indicate the percentage of marks obtained during registration.

3. Computer Literacy

Operating and working knowledge in computer systems is essential. Candidates should have a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations/Language, or have studied Computer/Information Technology as one of the subjects in High School/College/Institute.

4. Language Proficiency

Proficiency in the official language of the State/Union Territory for which you apply is a mandatory requirement. This includes reading, writing, and speaking the language. A Language Proficiency Test (LPT) may be conducted after the Mains exam.

Navigating the Application Process for IBPS Clerk 2026

The application process for IBPS Clerk 2026 will be conducted entirely online through the official IBPS website (www.ibps.in). Here’s a step-by-step guide to help you through:

1. Online Registration

Visit the official IBPS website and click on the 'CRP Clerks' section, then select 'Click Here For New Registration'. Provide your basic details like Name, Email ID, and Mobile Number to generate a provisional registration number and password.

2. Upload Documents

Upload scanned images of your passport-size photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration as per the specifications provided in the official notification.

✅ Photograph: 200x230 pixels, 20-50 KB, light background

✅ Signature: 140x60 pixels, 10-20 KB, black ink on white paper

✅ Thumb Impression: Clear scan in blue/black ink

✅ Handwritten Declaration: As per IBPS prescribed text

3. Fill Application Form

Proceed to fill in your personal, educational, and contact details. Carefully select your preferred state and participating banks.

4. Preview and Edit

Review all the entered information meticulously before final submission. No edits will be allowed after final submission.

5. Payment of Application Fee

Pay the application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI. The application fee is ₹850/- for General/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹175/- for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates. Remember, fees once paid are non-refundable.

6. Print Application

After successful payment, take a printout of your e-receipt and the submitted application form for your records.

Cracking the Exam: IBPS Clerk 2026 Exam Pattern & Syllabus

The IBPS Clerk selection process involves two main stages: Preliminary and Main Examinations. There is no interview round for the Clerk post. Both exams are objective-type, conducted online, and feature negative marking.

Preliminary Examination

The Prelims exam is qualifying in nature, meaning its marks are not counted for the final merit list. However, clearing it is mandatory to appear for the Mains exam.

Section No. of Questions Max Marks Time Allotted
English Language 30 30 20 minutes
Numerical Ability 35 35 20 minutes
Reasoning Ability 35 35 20 minutes
Total 100 100 60 minutes

✅ Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.

✅ Sectional Timing and Cut-offs are applicable.

Main Examination

The scores obtained in the Mains exam are solely considered for the final merit list and provisional allotment.

Section No. of Questions Max Marks Time Allotted
General/Financial Awareness 50 50 35 minutes
General English 40 40 35 minutes
Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude 50 60 45 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 50 50 45 minutes
Total 190 200 160 minutes

✅ Negative Marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.

✅ The exam will be bilingual (English and Hindi), except for the English Language section.

✅ Sectional timing and cut-offs are applicable.

IBPS Clerk 2026 Vacancies: What to Expect

The exact number of vacancies for IBPS Clerk 2026 (CRP CSA-XVI) will be announced with the official notification. However, based on previous years' trends, thousands of clerical posts are expected across participating Public Sector Banks.

The IBPS Clerk post has been officially renamed to Customer Service Associate (CSA) from CRP CSA-XVI onwards.

Here's a look at the IBPS Clerk vacancy trend from previous years for context:

Year Vacancies

Your Path to Success

With the IBPS Clerk Exam Dates 2026 already announced, now is the perfect time to kickstart or intensify your preparation. Understand the syllabus, practice with mock tests, and focus on improving your speed and accuracy. This opportunity offers a stable and rewarding career in Public Sector Banks, providing excellent growth prospects. Keep an eye on the official IBPS website for the release of the detailed notification in July/August 2026. Good luck with your preparation!
